facts.text: Under the New Hampshire Promise, incoming first-year state residents from families earning up to $100,000 annually attend tuition-free.

sources.title: The New Hampshire Promise | Keene State College
sources.quote: Beginning in Fall 2027, incoming first-year students who are New Hampshire residents and have a total family income of up to $100,000 a year can pay no tuition at any USNH institution, including UNH Durham, UNH Manchester, UNH College of Professional Studies Online, Keene State College, and Plymouth State University.
